scope: Read-only measurements of the preserved vendor-camera baseline SD image and extracted failed850 packed root. No layout or package changes performed.

baseline.partitionScheme: Rockchip raw SD; no populated MBR partition entries; U-Boot environment blkdevparts determines layout
baseline.measurementMethod: SHA-256 of complete image; raw environment printable-string extraction; existing FIT/squashfs probes; scan each preceding region in 4096-byte blocks and sum whole blocks containing any nonzero byte. This is neither filesystem allocated usage nor minimum safe partition size.

failed850.status: Build failed strict post-firmware startup verification; not a successful image release or boot result. Extracted packed root retained for read-only footprint analysis.
failed850.duMethod: du -sk on extracted squashfs; allocated filesystem blocks, not compressed contribution. Hardlinks prevent adding independently measured subtree totals blindly.
failed850.comparison: Old compressed rootfs is 42.65 MiB; failed850 compressed rootfs is approximately 44 MiB. Comparing either to the entire 347537408-byte old SD image would mix scopes. No final new whole-image size or large OS reduction is established.

candidates.evidence: 32 MiB boot and 256 MiB userdata precede rootfs; nonzero-block measurements are much smaller.
candidates.impact: Potentially large raw uncompressed image reduction; not an equivalent reduction in compressed Linux code. No proposed final size.
gates: Coordinate environment, raw image packer, boot/update offsets and filesystem size; do not truncate existing image.
Retain required writable capacity and boot growth margin.
Verify bootloader load paths, mounts, normal boot, physical power cycle and update/recovery.

candidates.change: Omit runtime Git and setuptools in a lean profile
candidates.evidence: OS already disables these for Mini NAND. Git core and setuptools occupy measured unpacked blocks above. App helpers/version.py invokes git rev-parse HEAD.
gates: Bake version metadata before removing Git.
Audit remaining startup/update/import dependencies and exercise app UI, QR, multisig and smartcard workflows.
Rebuild/repack to measure actual compressed saving.
Preserve all required notices and redistribution obligations; do not simply delete notices.
Review any generated smaller attribution bundle before shipping.

candidates.evidence: OEM subtree occupies 10356 KiB, including utilities and multimedia libraries. Not all are unused.
gates: Audit ELF dependencies, dynamic loading, startup scripts and camera/sensor/module requirements.
Keep required IQ, kernel modules and controls.
Verify final packed root and hardware boot/capture.

retainByDefault: Python/Pillow/fonts used by actual UI rendering
Crypto and smartcard dependencies used by wallet/card functionality
Camera kernel modules, selected sensor support and required runtime data
limits: Unpacked subtree sizes are not promised compressed savings.
No baseline config, active build, runtime or partition layout was modified.
Final successful packed image, whole-image hash/size and physical boot qualification remain separate acceptance gates.
